main_text.head: CAP. XXVII.
main_text.p: VERS. 1. Versum hunc & sequentem Æthiopicus sic reddidit, Tunc judicarunt & præceperunt ut abiret Paulus cum aliis qui custodiebantur, ad centurionem nomine Iulium, qui ex cohorte Augusta erat, ut irent in Italiam ad Cæsarem. Tunc ascenderunt in navem Adramuttenam quæ ibat versus Asiam, & solvimus ex eo loco, & direximus iter, & Aristarchus Macedonius Thessalonicensis, qui semper mansit nobiscum, adhærens nobis. Addimus hæc notis Cl. Bezæ. Arabs verbotenus sequitur Syrum.

VERS. 4. Τ᾽παραλλάξαμεν τὴν Κύπρον. Vulg. subnaviga-vimus Cyprum. Eras. subnavigamus juxta Cyprum. juxta non est in Græco. Beza, sublegimus Cyprum. nos vertimus, na-vigavimus infra Cyprum. ὑπό, sub, id est, infra. Si ventus tulisset, direxissent iter recto fere cursu Sidone Myram supra insulam Cyprum, relicta insula ad dextram. jam vero obliquare cursum, & infra insulam declinare debuerunt, relictâ ea ad sinistram, adeoque insulam quodammodo cir-cuire. hinc Syrus, [illegible, ~8 letters], cir-

page.notes: Syriac words at the ends of lines 5 and 9 of the Latin text and in the first two paragraphs are not legible enough to copy letter by letter and are marked illegible. The Greek at the head of VERS. 4 is read with doubt; the Greek verb should be checked against the scan. The catchword "cir-" at the foot is part of a hyphenated word and is given in the text as the last word of the page.
